name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 25, 2010
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Harlan Dunn, Member of Oak Hills Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation by the North Coastal Prevention Youth Coalition and the Youth Tobacco Prevention Corps.
P2.
Presentation of Certificate of Appointment to incoming Public Arts Commissioner Joyce Pekala.
P3.
Presentation by Lauren Greer and Becca Dawson regarding the 2010 San Diego County Fair.
P4.
Presentation by Kathy Kinane regarding the Vista Strawberry Festival and 5K.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Custodial Services Agreement for Civic Center (CC)
C4.
Energy Efficiency and Conservation Block Grant Award (CC)
C5.
Revisions to City Council Policy 700-07, Investment of City Funds (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Draft FY 2010/11 Operating Budget (CC/CDC/BSD)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Recreation and Community Services Facility Rental and Program Fees (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public testimony, close the public hearing, and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving the Recreation and Community Services facility rental and program fees.
PH2.
Property Lease for 127 Main Street (CC/CDC)
1.
Conduct a joint public hearing to receive public testimony regarding a lease agreement between the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista and the Vista Chamber of Commerce for property located at 127 Main Street, close the public hearing; (Recommendation continued on following page)
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving a lease agreement between the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista and the Vista Chamber of Commerce for the property located at 127 Main Street;
3.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2010- , authorizing the chairman to execute a lease agreement with the Vista Chamber of Commerce for the property at 127 Main Street, and authorizing the Executive Director to execute any and all documents and take any necessary actions to implement the lease; and
4.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2010- , amending the Operating Program Budget for the FY 2009/10.
PH3.
2010 Regional Transportation Improvement Plan (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public testimony, close the public hearing, and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , adopting the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2011 through 2015.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
